title: Random Kill Effects
description: A simple mod that gives the player a random effect after each kill
body:
# Random Kill Effects
## What does it do?

Random Kill Effects is a simple mod that grants the player a random status effect after each kill.

Note: This mod will only be active if the gamerule "Grant Random Effect" is set to true, if not the player will not get any effects when killing a mob.

## What effects are available?

Currently, only vanilla Minecraft status effects are supported. Modded effects may be supported in a future update.

## How long can effects last?

Effects can last anywhere from 1 second to 5 minutes.

## What effect levels are possible?

Status effects can be applied with an amplifier ranging from Level I to Level V.
